evidenceNote: Literature prior only. Nothing here was identified on CRANE data or a CRANE vehicle. Each coefficient carries its own origin from the source table (Experimental / CAD / Eidsvik empirical / Defined).

frames.body: FRD, origin at CO = CG (von Benzon 2022 Table A1: (xg,yg,zg) = (0,0,0) 'Defined')
frames.signConvention: Added mass and damping are stored as POSITIVE magnitudes, M_A = -diag(X_udot, ...), D = -diag(X_u, ...). von Benzon 2022 prints positive magnitudes; Wu 2018 prints negative SNAME derivatives.

vonbenzon2022.citation: M. von Benzon, F. F. Sorensen, E. Uth, J. Jouffroy, J. Liniger, S. Pedersen, 'An Open-Source Benchmark Simulator: Control of a BlueROV2 Underwater Robot', J. Mar. Sci. Eng. 10(12):1898, 2022

bluerobotics_t200.citation: Blue Robotics, T200 Public Performance Data 10-20V, September 2019
bluerobotics_t200.license: UNVERIFIED (no terms stated on the product page). Cite facts only; do not redistribute the spreadsheet.

crane_derived.citation: Derived in this profile from the cited primary values; derivation in 'location'.

weightN.location: W = m g = 13.5 * 9.82 (von Benzon eq. 8 definition W = mg)

buoyancyN.location: B = rho g nabla = 1000 * 9.82 * 0.0134 (von Benzon eq. 8 definition). Net W - B = +0.98 N (slightly heavy).

u.location: Table A1, X_udot (Eidsvik empirical, ref [33]; paper sec. 2 notes relative error vs physical robot)

maxForwardN.location: von Benzon eq. 18 F(V) at V=+1: -140.3+389.9-404.1+176.0+8.9 = 30.4 N. Consistent with Table 4: 4*30.4*cos(45deg) = 86 N surge (paper 85 N), 4*30.4 = 122 N heave (paper 120 N).

maxReverseN.location: von Benzon eq. 18 is odd in V: F(-1) = -30.4 N. The T200 data sheet (bluerobotics_t200) is asymmetric; fit it separately before use.

value.form: odd polynomial in normalised command V in [-1,1]

timeConstantS.location: 63 % rise time of the unit-step response of von Benzon eq. 19 (poles -13.16, -37.9 +- 82.6j; zero -17.7; no overshoot), computed with python -I. First-order surrogate only.

layout.location: Table 4.2 (arms, mm) and p.41 rotation angles pi/4, -pi/4, -3pi/4, 3pi/4 with Fx = F cos(a), Fy = -F sin(a). Positions match von Benzon Table A1 r_i = J3(alpha_i)[0.156 0.111 0.085], alpha = {0, 5.05, 1.91, pi}, and r_5..8 = J3(gamma_i)[0.120 0.218 0]. Vertical direction [0,0,-1] is from von Benzon Table A1. CONFLICT: von Benzon's printed beta_i = {0, pi/2, 3pi/4, pi} makes T3 point along pure +y (not 45 deg) and T4 opposite to Wu's T4, so it is treated as a typesetting error. The per-thruster positive-command sign (propeller handedness) is UNVERIFIED and must be measured on hardware.

alternatePrior.note: Wu 2018 a-priori values (standard BlueROV2 numbers transferred from Sandoy) kept as an independent prior to bound uncertainty. Not loaded by to_params().
